rule.description: A recording-pipeline class whose own member functions directly implement method bodies belonging to at least 5 of 6 unrelated technical concern families (media-codec, filesystem-ops, raw-buffer-ownership, stream-io, text-render, numeric-name-padding) is a god class; the same rule also reports responsibility-transfer evidence where a nested helper class's member function routes its implementation into a static member of the enclosing class. Scope: the pipeline classes declared in the reader's sensorData.h.

checks.description: Detects a pipeline class whose own member functions directly implement the bodies of unrelated technical concerns spanning at least 5 of the 6 recognized families.
checks.detected_relation: pipeline class -> foreign concern families implemented in its own member functions
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The recording type concentrates several distinct pipeline responsibilities in one declaration instead of delegating them to their cohesive owners.

matches.evidence: ml::SensorData's own member functions directly implement media decoding entry points, platform directory APIs, raw heap-buffer primitives, stream/cstdio file IO, formatted text assembly, and zero-padded numeric formatting at once; roughly 24 of its 52 declared member functions carry such bodies.

checks.description: Detects a nested helper class whose member function hands its implementation over to a static member of the enclosing class, including every lifecycle and dispatch entry point that routes this way.
checks.detected_relation: nested helper member -> enclosing-class static implementing its responsibility
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The data-owning types no longer implement their own responsibilities; the behavior that manipulates their state lives one level up in the concentrated class.

matches.evidence: Frame construction routes both compressFrameColor and compressFrameDepth of its color/depth payload into ml::SensorData statics.
Releasing the frame's compressed buffers routes into ml::SensorData::freeFrameColor / freeFrameDepth.
Depth replacement routes release and re-compression into ml::SensorData::freeFrameDepth / compressFrameDepth.
Color replacement routes release and re-compression into ml::SensorData::freeFrameColor / compressFrameColor.
Color format dispatch forwards its backend branches into ml::SensorData::decompressFrameColorAlloc_* statics.
Depth format dispatch forwards all three backend branches into ml::SensorData::decompressFrameDepthAlloc_* statics.
The intrinsic-matrix factory is a forwarder; the matrix construction is implemented by ml::SensorData::makeIntrinsicMatrix.
The zero-padded frame-name formatting is implemented by ml::SensorData::buildFrameFilename; the sequence counter forwards to it.

excluded.candidate: ml::SensorData::IMUFrame and the RGBDFrameCacheRead/RGBDFrameCacheWrite nested classes
excluded.reason: State containers whose member functions implement no independent concern families and route nothing into the enclosing class; not manifestations of the concentration.
A concurrency concern in the same header; its members do not join the recording-pipeline responsibility relation measured by this rule.

excluded.candidate: SensReader GUI/converter tools (Converter, AnnotationTools, Calibrate, Filter2dAnnotations)
excluded.reason: Not declared in the scoped pipeline header; each carries its own mLib helper copies and does not share the rule's scope.
Serialization of the recording is the recording type's own responsibility, not an absorbed foreign one.
